test_sequence_feature_extraction_propert: test the SequenceFeatureExtractionTestMixin class verifies feature_size, sampling_rate, and padding_value attributes
test_batch_feature_processing: test the BatchFeature class processes speech inputs and validates batch feature shapes for numpy tensors
test_batch_feature_pytorch: test the BatchFeature class converts speech inputs to PyTorch tensors and validates output shapes
test_padding_functionality: test the feature extractor pad method supports longest, max_length, and pad_to_multiple_of strategies
test_truncation_functionality: test the feature extractor pad method with truncation forces equal-length outputs and raises errors on invalid padding modes
test_attention_mask_generation: test the feature extractor generates attention masks that sum to correct input lengths
test_attention_mask_with_truncation: test the feature extractor generates attention masks correctly when truncation and max_length padding are combined
